name: After recital 3
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: (3b) The Emissions Trading Scheme for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors (ETS2) should be abolished, and the provisions of EU law relating to the introduction and implementation of this scheme should be repealed, in order to avoid placing an additional burden on citizens and businesses, particularly through higher heating and transport costs.
